# Kaleb Dida Abera (Kal)

> Aspiring cognitive scientist. Human-centered AI and software. Based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Minds, machines, and the locks between them.

I'm Kal, an aspiring cognitive scientist currently based in Addis Ababa. I build human-centered software, play CTFs, and want to become an AI engineer.

How minds work, how machines think, and how to keep those machines safe.

I graduated from Adama Science and Technology University Special School (ASTU SPS) in July 2026, first in my section every year. This is my gap year before studying cognitive science: I’m building Logbook, competing in CTFs, and teaching weekly Bible lessons to kids in my neighborhood.

Logbook is what I’m building right now. It’s a private, offline-first journal with an AI companion that asks me a question every day and remembers past entries and photos. It’s how I’ve been exploring whether software can support memory and self-reflection.

Before that came a summer of neuroscience research with ThinkNeuro, the INSA cyber talent program, a four-person robotics team I led, and a Peace Club I founded that grew to 63 members.

## Projects
- [Logbook](https://kalebdida.github.io/projects): A private, offline-first journal with an AI companion that asks a daily question and remembers past entries and photos.
- [ThinkNeuro research](https://kalebdida.github.io/projects): A bibliometric review of the 100 most-cited papers on detecting adolescent depression and anxiety with wearable nanotechnology and biofeedback.
- [Obstacle-avoidance robot](https://kalebdida.github.io/projects): A sensor-based robot that detects and steers around obstacles, built by a team of four that I led.
- [Church Finder](https://kalebdida.github.io/projects): Find the churches near you, starting with every church in Addis Ababa.

## Journey
- Before 2022: Saint Joseph Catholic School
- 2020 to 2024: Part-time at PJ Masks Playground. Waiter, cashier and children’s play attendant, mostly on Saturdays, for four years.
- 2022 to 2026: Debate club. Researched and argued three team rounds on school systems. We won.
- 2023: Led a robotics team. Four of us built a robot that detects and steers around obstacles.
- 2023 to 2024: INSA cyber talent program. Selected trainee in the national program for young technical talent. Studied how systems fail, how attackers think, and how to defend.
- 2023 to present: Capture the flag. Three contests so far, solo and on teams. Best finish: 9th of 53 teams.
- 2023 to present: Volunteer Bible teacher. Weekly Sunday lessons for 12 neighborhood children.
- 2024 to 2025: Research intern at ThinkNeuro. A bibliometric review on adolescent depression and anxiety, presented at the ThinkNeuro research symposium.
- 2025 to 2026: Founded the Peace Club. YMCA-affiliated, at my school. Grew it to 63 members and led two sessions a week on gender-based violence and peacekeeping.
- 2025 to 2026: Organized a summer school. A two-month program for 36 students, over 90% of them girls, most from families who couldn’t afford tutoring. Prepared grade 6 and 8 students for national exams.
- July 2026: Graduated from ASTU SPS. First in my section every year.
- 2026 to 2027: Gap year. Building Logbook, competing in CTFs, teaching Bible lessons.

## Recognition
- 1st place, The World in Us writing competition, for a piece on teaching discipline in the digital age (International)
- 2nd place, STEMpower program (Citywide)
- 4th place, National online English competition (National)
- Stage 4 of 6, National mathematics olympiad (National)
- 9th of 53, Best team finish in a capture the flag contest
